phases.name: Inventory & Current State
phases.description: Run hermes commands and capture current state of all auth providers and models

phases.name: Web Research Pipeline
phases.description: Use web-research-pipeline to gather all provider documentation and model info
actions: Search web for each provider's free models

phases.name: Catalog Building & Model Testing
phases.description: Build free-model catalog and test each model via hermes chat --oneshot
actions: Test each model with standardized prompts
Capture results with Provider, Context, max-output, capabilities

phases.name: Ranking & Configuration
phases.description: Rank models and configure Hermes primary + fallback chain
actions: Configure primary model via hermes config set
Configure fallback chain via hermes fallback clear/add

phases.name: Verification & Audit
phases.description: Run prompts-judge and verify all configurations
